quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: asked whether its liquid-cooling products had entered Lenovo's liquid-cooled server supply chain, it said it has long-term cooperation with that customer, supplying thermal materials, graphite, fans and cooling modules, but currently does not supply it server liquid-cooling products. It also said its data-center and server customers include Datang Mobile alongside 'Company H' (as the company names it), ZTE, Cisco, Inspur, New H3C, xFusion, Lenovo, Wistron, Eastern Communications and Shenzhou Kuntai, and that confidentiality agreements with some customers prevent disclosing details.
